alkylation_reagent: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue
cleavage_agent: as well as trypsin endopeptidase specificity on C-terminal with 2 max. missed cleavages was set.
labeling: triplicate biological replicates were processed using TMTpro 18-plex labeling and high-resolution Orbitrap mass spectrometry with FAIMS.
mass_analyzer: high-resolution Orbitrap mass spectrometry with FAIMS.
ptm: Static modifications were set for carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues (+57.021 Da) and TMTpro labels on lysine residues and N-termini of peptides (+304.207 Da); variable modification was set for oxidization of methionine residues (+15.995 Da).
